Together these chunks answer the question completely.

answer.answer: Under the Laws of Badminton 5.0 (2), in force 2025-04-26, the service judge shall call service faults made by the server should they occur (Law 9.1.2 to 9.1.8) [laws-17.3]. Under the Instructions to Technical Officials 7.0 (5), in force 2025-04-26, "If not, call “Fault” loudly and use the approved hand signal to indicate the type of infringement" [itto-7.2], and Law 9.1.6 states that the whole shuttle shall be below 1.15 metres from the surface of the court at the instant of being hit by the server’s racket [itto-7.4]. The sources do not say what the service judge's signal for a serve hit too high looks like.

If not, call “Fault” loudly and use the approved hand signal to indicate the type of infringement.
